name: sponge
description: Save articles and PDFs to a reading library captured by a computer you control. Highlight passages, keep notes, and find ideas through search or your coding agent.

interface.longDescription:
Save articles and PDFs to a reading library captured by a computer you control. Highlight passages, keep notes, and find ideas through search or your coding agent.

Requires the separately installed @hraness/sponge CLI, Node.js 24.20.0 or later and an initialized local library.
